title: Drafts Through the Payment Method on File for TRICARE Prime Enrollment Fees
content:
When the beneficiary asks for an amount owed on a fee-bearing **TRICARE Prime** enrollment to be collected through the payment method the enrollment keeps on file, the region draws it that way; the region draws nothing on an enrollment that took effect in the current plan year.

## Conditions on a draft

- A draft toward a back-billed installment is made only after an installment charge on the account has a coverage period that reaches the month before the current month.
- No draft is made on an account until the region has made the duplicate refund owed on it, wherever that refund comes to more than nothing.
- The region does not draw a back-billed installment until the installment of the current month stands paid in full.

Put the other way round: while no installment charge on the account has a coverage period reaching the month before the current month, nothing is drawn toward a back-billed installment; and while the installment of the current month does not stand paid in full, no back-billed installment is drawn.

## What the draft does

One payment is added to the fee account against the installment named, made through the enrollment's payment method on file (its recurring card, electronic funds transfer account or allotment) with today's posting date, and the enrollment's fee balance owed falls by the amount drawn. The draft then shows on the fee account against that installment.

## Invocation

The tool is `run_draft_on_file_method_99529347`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it for the verified caller.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `prime_enrollment_id` | the reference number of the fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment whose payment method on file is drawn, read from the Prime enrollment lookup | identifier, as returned |
| `related_fee_entry_id` | the reference number of the installment charge the draft pays toward, read from the fee-account lookup | identifier, as returned |
| `amount` | the amount drawn | US dollars, a plain number with 2 decimal places (cents, rounded half up), greater than 0.00 |

## Return

On success: `drawn` (true when the draft was taken), `prime_fee_entry_id` (the payment's reference number, beginning "pfd"), `related_fee_entry_id` (the installment charge paid toward), `payment_method` (the enrollment's payment method on file), `amount` (USD, 2 decimals) and `fee_balance_due` (the fee balance owed after the draft, USD, 2 decimals; negative means a credit owed to the beneficiary). No other outcome is defined.
